description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of clone operations in a Perforce and Git integration, specifically focusing on case sensitivity and path variations.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server with specific options for testing.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configures the client workspace view in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository using git-p4.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists files in the current Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Performed cleanup after a test case.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git environment after tests.
